title: Seaside Serenity | Studio - 30A Five Star Properties
description_expanded:
🌊 Sterling Reef — Private Studio with Balcony + Gulf Views Studio • 1 BA • Sleeps 2 • Private Entrance

✨ Highlights • Private studio with its own entrance • Gulf-view balcony perfect for morning coffee • King bed • Private full bathroom • Mini-fridge, microwave & essentials • Access to heated pool, fitness center & sky BBQ terrace • High-speed WiFi + garage parking

🏡 The Space Ideal for couples, solo travelers, or guests seeking a peaceful getaway, this studio offers comfort with a touch of luxury. Enjoy a private balcony with refreshing Gulf breezes and beautiful shoreline views. The space includes a cozy seating area and essential amenities for a relaxing stay.

🛏️ Sleeping Arrangements • King Bed (sleeps 2)

🌴 Amenities • Heated bi-level pool • Gulf-view fitness center • Sky BBQ terrace • Water sports & rentals onsite

📍 Location • Steps from Bay County Fishing Pier • Across from Shipwreck Island Waterpark • Minutes to dining, shopping & PCB attractions

🚗 Parking HOA charges a $50 one-time parking fee per car (virtual permit). Park anywhere not labeled “Do Not Park.”

📅 Off-Season Ask about discounted off-season rates for longer stays!
